name: Leaderboard
description: A panel that shows one of your game's boards. Point it at the game.state key your game writes the rows to; two panels on two keys are two boards, two on the same key show the same places. Works with: Game Flow.

changelog.notes: Rebuilt on the game API: the panel is now a pure reader of a game.state key you choose (boardKey), so the board a script keeps is the board every player sees and a late joiner gets it from the snapshot. The server-side score store, the personal best and the weekly rollover are gone — a game that wants an all-time board folds it into game.saved and copies the top N into game.state. The board, sort, rollover and rows params became title, boardKey, sort and rows: update a placed copy so its script settings line up again.
Initial release: named boards the server owns, a personal best kept per wallet, weekly rollover, and a panel that paints the top places
